locator.name: reads the catalogue once on entry, opens on the task context, then asks the review only for the subject chosen

proves.facet: Opening the review page with no subject issues exactly one task-context intent read before the held catalogue is released. Its late answer fills family rows without selecting a subject or reading another review. An unrelated analytics publication keeps one catalogue read; each explicit family selection asks only that family review, and a new-snapshot refresh rereads the catalogue once.

realizes.rationale: Historical attachment of the already-retired L86/R87 carriage record; source callback adaptation is not a new execution or current native acceptance claim.
